cinnamonMassStatus: Existing pilot assumes 1 tsp = 2.6 g without a cited measure. This package requires an explicitly weighed 2.6 g version or independent measure verification; original recipe not edited.

templateSourceCard.food: Fixed weighed culinary ground spice, seed or vanilla extract
templateSourceCard.location: Explicit project extension of coding default, not directly published for these foods
templateSourceCard.limitations: Own project extension of coding default, not measured food GI or directly published Schakel scope. Full composition and consumed grams mandatory; <=0.5 g CHO each and <=1 g aggregate per serving. Includes named vanilla extract, dried herbs and whole seed garnish. Excludes flour, baking powder, bulk paste, sugar, unknown extraction and sticks/pods. No biological error bound. USDA total-carbohydrate minus fibre is a disclosed available-CHO proxy; endogenous polyols unquantified, not asserted zero. This additional proxy use awaits owner method approval.
